spotlight.title: Confirm the pause is a deliberate hold — and name the resume trigger
spotlight.detail: The one paid motion is halted. Frankie set “$300 Plan” Active→Inactive in Power Editor on 9/6 at 10:47 AM PT — not a watchdog kill gate, a human call, made ~1 minute after the first V2 lead notification arrived flagged “no TCPA consent.” Since then: $0 spend, 0 impressions, 0 leads. That is roughly a full day of the 10-day V2 window gone at zero spend, with $70.07 of the $200 tranche used and ~$130 still unspent. Read most likely as a responsible reflex to the no-consent lead — but the watchdog cannot confirm intent and has no authority to resume it. The move today: Frankie states plainly whether this is an intentional hold and what has to be true to restart (consent handling fixed + b3/b7 placed), because the 10-day clock burns whether or not a dollar moves.

spotlight.title: The brake WAS a compliance signal — b3/b7 still 0/7, and a live call is now booked for Friday
spotlight.detail: The lead that tripped the pause came in flagged “no TCPA consent — call by hand, no AI/SMS,” which is the funnel behaving correctly. The gap is upstream: b7 (CA producer license # on every creative + landing page) and b3 (TX telephone-solicitor registration, $200 + $10K bond) are still unfiled ~12 days after the first real leads, and five creatives are live without the license #. What makes it concrete today: a score-100 TX test lead ran the full funnel and booked a real slot on Frankie’s calendar for Fri 9/11, 4:30 PM CDT. Before that becomes a real dial — NPN + license # on the creatives, open the TX registration, or write the one-line rule: call NV/ID only until b3/b7 are placed.

spotlight.title: “Pipeline broken” was a false read — the V2 path works; fix the alarm, dedupe, and dual-recipient delivery
spotlight.detail: Six straight watchdog runs cried “pipeline break,” but the 10:40Z run found the cause: the capture email switched to a NEW template (“[Lead 80] Mary Grossman, NV … no consent, call by hand”), so the old exact-subject check (“NEW LEAD CAPTURED IN $300 PLAN”) matched nothing. The form→sheet→n8n→email path actually works — today’s score-100 TX test proves capture→book→confirm end-to-end — but it (a) delivered to hanfluxai@ only, not manifestdestiny247@, and (b) can’t be trusted run-to-run. Fix the subject match + dedupe, restore both recipients, and wire a real CRM booked-call source so cost-per-booked-call finally computes (still blank on every run).
